$comment: The tokens that mark a comment as history rather than contract — javadoc-conventions.md rule 12, tsdoc-conventions.md rule 12, comment-conventions.md. It sits beside labels.yml and labels-from-verdict.json because it is the same kind of thing: taxonomy data a check applies, not a rule a check restates. Three consumers read it — scripts/comment_history_check.py directly, ts/eslint.tsdoc.mjs by import, and java/checkstyle-javadoc.xml through a regenerated `format` attribute, because Checkstyle reads no JSON. scripts/comment_history_suite.py asserts all three carry this list; `comment_history_check.py --emit-checkstyle` prints what the XML must hold. Each alternative is anchored to the verb or the number that makes it past-referential: an unanchored list fires on present-tense English and a check that is wrong most of the time is one people learn to ignore. `no longer` and a bare `previously` are deliberately absent and left to review.
